compiled_state.title: Skeleton merge-to-main-pr.sh: gh version check + duplicate-PR guard
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD7: script exits 1 with clear error message when gh CLI version lacks GraphQL support
- DD4: script detects an existing open PR for the same branch and fails with a clear error rather than creating a duplicate PR
- DD6 (partial — PR side): CONFLICT_DATA schema parity in PR mode, foundational stub

## Description
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh` (executable, `chmod +x`) with:
- `set -euo pipefail`; enforce `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:?}` and `${MERGE_STRATEGY:?}` env vars (set by the dispatcher)
- Source `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh`
- CLI parsing for `--resume`, `--help` (mirror direct.sh's surface)
- `_state_init` call (reuses helpers' state-file pattern: `/tmp/merge-to-main-state-${branch//\//-}.json`)
- gh version check: parse `gh --version | awk '{print $3; exit}'`; compare against `2.0.0` via `sort -V`. On too-old: print "ERROR: gh CLI 2.0.0+ required for PR-mode merge (found <version>)" to stderr and exit 1.
- Duplicate-PR guard: `gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --state open --json number,url --jq '.[0].url'`. If non-empty, print "ERROR: open PR already exists for branch <branch>: <url>" and exit non-zero.
- PR-mode CONFLICT_DATA emission: when `_phase_merge` fails (placeholder for now — full PR-create logic in Task 3), call `_emit_conflict_data "$BRANCH" "main" "pr-auto-merge"`.

This task makes the dispatcher routing test (`test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script`) and `test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent` from T1 turn GREEN. The actual PR-creation logic is Task 3.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (create, chmod +x)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] PR script is executable
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] gh version < 2.0 short-circuits with clear error
  Verify: bash -c 'tmp=$(mktemp -d); printf "#!/bin/sh\necho gh version 1.14.0 (anything)\n" > "$tmp/gh"; chmod +x "$tmp/gh"; PATH="$tmp:$PATH" CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$(pwd)/plugins/dso MERGE_STRATEGY=pr bash plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -qiE "gh.*2\\.0"; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; test $rc -eq 0'
- [ ] T1 dispatcher routing + PR CONFLICT_DATA tests now pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "test_dispatcher_routes_to_pr_script.*PASS|test_conflict_data_schema_pr_equivalent.*PASS" | wc -l | awk '$1 >= 2'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
